description: Animation/cel content Topaz Video AI upscale preset -- uses Gaia Animation (ganim-1) instead of Gaia Computer-Generated (gcg-5). gcg-5 is tuned for aliasing/moire on CG-rendered footage; on flat-color hand-drawn/cel animation with hard black outlines it can produce edge ghosting/haloing. ganim-1 is Topaz's model specifically trained for this content type.
_note_scale: ganim-1 only supports a fixed 2x AI scale (confirmed from its model json) -- unlike gcg-5's 1/2/4. For sources needing more than 2x to reach the output tier, the remainder is a plain (non-AI) bicubic resize after the AI pass.

encoder._note: Topaz's bundled ffmpeg (needed for the tvai_up filter) has no libx264 -- only hardware encoders -- so h264_nvenc is the only option in this same process. Lower cq = higher quality/bigger files.
